subject.title: improve(models): source pricing from hosted catalog

question: Should OpenClaw retire the public `models.pricing` toggle in favor of the hosted-catalog refresh contract, with `openclaw doctor --fix` as the upgrade path for existing configuration?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes an operator-facing setting and changes the control point for remote pricing traffic; tests can verify mechanics, but maintainers must confirm that this is the supported product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve the catalog-owned pricing contract
options.body: Retire `models.pricing`, document `models.catalogRefresh.enabled` as the remote-traffic control, and rely on Doctor to migrate existing files.

options.title: Preserve an explicit pricing control
options.body: Keep or replace the retired setting only if maintainers need pricing refresh to be independently controllable from hosted model-catalog refresh.

recommendation.title: Approve the catalog-owned pricing contract
recommendation.body: Retire `models.pricing`, document `models.catalogRefresh.enabled` as the remote-traffic control, and rely on Doctor to migrate existing files.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit series shows direct ownership of the proposed catalog, migration, and Gateway-lifecycle design.
